articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic and rivals seek AI agent rules to prevent commerce chaos
articles.snippet: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other technology giants are backing standards designed to enable agents to work together without putting any one company in control.

articles.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
articles.snippet: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

articles.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $59,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
articles.snippet: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.
